CODESPAR_API_KEY.description: Test key from https://dashboard.codespar.dev (starts with csk_test_). A live key is refused. Set it as a Codespaces secret, never in a committed file.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional. From https://console.anthropic.com. Leave it unset to replay the recorded happy path.

CODESPAR_API_URL.description: Staging keys only: https://api.staging.codespar.dev. A production key needs nothing here.
